methodToolbox.name: map
methodToolbox.signature: fn map<B, F>(self, f: F) -> Map<Self, F> where F: FnMut(Self::Item) -> B
methodToolbox.description: Lays down an un-evaluated transformation adaptor over an iterator stream.
methodToolbox.contract: Zero allocations; consumes self by value; f is invoked lazily on demand during next().

methodToolbox.name: filter
methodToolbox.signature:
fn filter

(self, predicate: P) -> Filter where P: FnMut(&Self::Item) -> bool
methodToolbox.description: Yields only elements satisfying the predicate closure.
methodToolbox.contract: Predicate receives an immutable borrow; does not advance past stream ends.

methodToolbox.name: fold
methodToolbox.signature: fn fold<B, F>(mut self, init: B, mut f: F) -> B where F: FnMut(B, Self::Item) -> B
methodToolbox.description: Strict terminal consumer that reduces the entire stream into a single accumulator.
methodToolbox.contract: Eagerly drives the pipeline; compiler unrolls into a single branch-predicted register loop.

methodToolbox.name: collect
methodToolbox.description: Reifies the lazy stream into a concrete target collection (e.g. Vec<T>).
methodToolbox.contract: Leverages size_hint() to pre-allocate exact capacity in one heap allocation.

mechanicalLowering.staticLowering: Monomorphization: LLVM flattens Iterator pipeline struct wrappers into a tight register-bound assembly loop, eliminating closure function pointers via inlining.
mechanicalLowering.dynamicLowering: Optional Box<dyn Iterator<Item = T>> fat pointer (data pointer + vtable pointer) for heterogeneous stream collections.
mechanicalLowering.memoryLayout: Stack-allocated composite struct (e.g. Map<Filter<I, P>, F>); zero heap allocation until collect().
mechanicalLowering.cacheImpact: Ultra-dense cache line locality; elements stream sequentially through L1 data cache without pointer chasing.

forwardChain.title: Vector Registers & ALU
forwardChain.description: Loop arithmetic executes inside CPU scalar/SIMD registers without bus memory roundtrips.

forwardChain.title: Branch Predictor & L1 Cache
forwardChain.description: Inlined loop bodies minimize instruction-cache misses and allow hardware loop stream prefetching.

forwardChain.title: LLVM Inlining & Monomorphization
forwardChain.description: Nested iterator types Map<Filter<...>> are completely erased into flat basic blocks.

forwardChain.title: Trait Contracts & Ownership
forwardChain.description: Closures capture environment by reference (&T) or value (move), verified by borrow checker.

forwardChain.title: Declarative Mental Model
forwardChain.description: Engineer thinks in pure declarative data pipelines without paying GC pauses or heap allocation overhead.

mentalModel.coreMetaphor: A factory conveyor belt assembled at compile time: no moving parts until the final lever (fold/collect) is pulled.
mentalModel.cognitiveShift: Stop thinking of iterators as stateful OOP cursor objects. Think of them as compile-time assembly loop blueprints.
mentalModel.antiPatternToUnlearn: Do not allocate intermediate Vec arrays between transformation steps; keep the stream lazy until final collection.

syntaxPrimitives: data Maybe a = Nothing | Just a

methodToolbox.name: fmap / (<$>)
methodToolbox.description: Lifts a pure function into any Functor context without altering structure.
methodToolbox.contract: Preserves identity (fmap id == id) and composition (fmap (f . g) == fmap f . fmap g).

methodToolbox.name: bind / (>>=)
methodToolbox.signature: m a -> (a -> m b) -> m b
methodToolbox.description: Sequences monadic computations, feeding the unwrapped value of the first into the second.
methodToolbox.contract: Enforces mathematical monad laws (left identity, right identity, associativity).

methodToolbox.name: foldr
methodToolbox.description: Right-associative fold capable of terminating early on infinite streams due to laziness.
methodToolbox.contract: Operates lazily; f decides whether to force the recursive tail evaluation.

mechanicalLowering.staticLowering: GHC STG (Spineless Tagless G-machine) lowers computations into heap-allocated thunks evaluated via call-by-need graph reduction.
mechanicalLowering.dynamicLowering: Dictionary passing for typeclasses; GHC specializer eliminates dictionaries via INLINE pragmas when concrete types are known.
mechanicalLowering.memoryLayout: Boxed pointers referencing heap thunks; forced values update thunk pointers with indirection tags to memoize results.
mechanicalLowering.cacheImpact: Pointer chasing through heap-allocated thunks can strain L2/L3 cache lines unless unboxed via worker-wrapper transformation.

forwardChain.title: Clock Cycles & Memory Bus
forwardChain.description: Graph reduction involves continuous pointer dereferencing on the memory bus.

forwardChain.title: GHC Core & STG Machine
forwardChain.description: Expressions become thunk allocation blocks that defer execution until demanded by WHNF.

forwardChain.title: Mathematical Purity & Monads
forwardChain.description: Type system physically separates pure computation from IO side-effects; unsafePerformIO is forbidden.

forwardChain.title: Equational Reasoning
forwardChain.description: The engineer can replace any expression with its definition everywhere without altering program meaning.

mentalModel.coreMetaphor: A spreadsheet formula network: values do not exist until a cell visible on the screen demands them.
mentalModel.cognitiveShift: Abandon step-by-step sequential time. Think in terms of timeless equational definitions and lazy demand.
mentalModel.antiPatternToUnlearn: Do not build huge unevaluated thunk chains in accumulators; use foldl strict evaluation when accumulating numbers.

methodToolbox.name: go statement
methodToolbox.description: Spawns an asynchronous concurrent green execution thread managed by the Go runtime scheduler.
methodToolbox.contract: Stack starts at 2KB and grows dynamically; runs cooperatively on M:N OS threads.

methodToolbox.name: channel send/recv
methodToolbox.description: Synchronous or buffered message passing channel transferring ownership without shared memory locks.
methodToolbox.contract: Blocks when unbuffered until rendezvous; panics on sending to closed channel.

methodToolbox.name: select statement
methodToolbox.signature: select { case <-ch1: ... case ch2 <- v: ... default: ... }
methodToolbox.description: Multiplexes across multiple channel communications simultaneously.
methodToolbox.contract: Pseudo-random fair selection among ready channels; non-blocking if default clause is provided.

mechanicalLowering.staticLowering: Compiler inserts runtime call runtime.newproc for go statements and runtime.chansend / chanrecv for channel operators.
mechanicalLowering.dynamicLowering: Go M:N scheduler (GOMAXPROCS OS threads multiplexing thousands of G goroutines on P processor queues).
mechanicalLowering.memoryLayout: Channels are heap-allocated hchan structs with lock-free ring buffers and wait queues of waiting goroutines.
mechanicalLowering.cacheImpact: Goroutine work-stealing scheduler maintains local run queues per P to preserve CPU cache affinity.

forwardChain.title: Multi-Core CPU Sockets
forwardChain.description: Hardware OS threads distribute execution across physical silicon processor cores.

forwardChain.title: Kernel Threads & epoll
forwardChain.description: Go netpoller converts blocking I/O into kernel epoll/kqueue event loops without blocking OS threads.

forwardChain.title: Go M:N Work Stealing
forwardChain.description: Thousands of goroutines share 8-16 OS threads with 2KB growing stacks.

forwardChain.title: CSP Data Pipelines
forwardChain.description: Communicating Sequential Processes: Do not communicate by sharing memory; share memory by communicating.

forwardChain.title: Straight-Line Synchronous Code
forwardChain.description: Developer writes simple, readable linear code without callback hell or promise chaining.

mentalModel.coreMetaphor: Pipes connecting independent workers: workers do not reach into each other toolboxes; they drop sealed parts onto conveyor chutes.
mentalModel.cognitiveShift: Stop protecting shared mutable variables with fine-grained mutexes. Model workflows as independent workers passing messages.
mentalModel.antiPatternToUnlearn: Never spawn a goroutine without knowing how and when it will terminate; avoid channel leaks.
